events.rootCause: Auth ownership was split across legacy Netlify Identity, Supabase customer auth and legacy portal render/lifecycle code; backend HTTP 200 did not prove usable device UI.
events.failedApproach: Repeated inline patches; only bypassing Netlify Identity; reload/direct-open only; persistence while fields remained in re-rendering DOM; treating backend 200 or Netlify READY as device proof.
events.fix: Use klant-login.html as the single editable auth boundary; Supabase password/magic-link plus RLS; persist session outside legacy inline lifecycle; legacy toonInlog redirects to isolated login; return to the same customer slug and preserve offer/sprint portal.

events.rootCause: Shared Agent Memory workflow omitted main from push branches.
events.failedApproach: Treating PR-only or automation-only validation as complete production governance.
events.fix: Run Shared Agent Memory Tests on main pushes as well as candidate branches and PRs, and regression-test the trigger.

events.rootCause: Authorized connector capability was treated as governed delivery while main lacked native protection; branch omission bypassed the candidate/PR route.
events.failedApproach: create_file/update_file with branch omission or main target, then treating post-push CI as prevention proof.
events.fix: Read current main; create fresh non-main candidate; pass branch explicitly; RED/GREEN only on candidate SHAs; run Unified BRAIN; promote exact tested head; read main back.

events.rootCause: Append-only memory was updated via broad full-file replacement without a gate forbidding changes to prior evidence.

events.fix: Keep prior records immutable; append or create explicit correction/superseding records; inspect final diff for historical mutations before promotion; restore accidental changes before exact-head gates.
